payload.posture: Read John 17:1–5 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus lifts his eyes, says the hour has come, asks for mutual glorification, speaks of authority and eternal life, and asks for the glory he had before the world existed. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
